trip.name: Spain Is On
trip.tagline: Nine days. Three cities. One absurd amount of pintxos. You're invited to follow along.
trip.summary: Tasting menus at Toga and Amelia, a backstreet pintxos tour, and one Hertz BMW X3 pointed north through the Basque hills.
